v2 · System & Components.name: NF2/TL Toggle
v2 · System & Components.description: Layer column toggle: Visibility (dot / red X), Lock (dot / lock), Outline (solid swatch / outline-only swatch, recolour Swatch per layer).

v2 · System & Components.name: NF2/TL Layer
v2 · System & Components.description: Timeline layer row. Type = Flash layer kinds (normal, masked, folder, guide, motion guide, mask). Indent 1/2 nest rows under folders, masks and motion guides. Editing shows the pencil on the current layer. Column toggles are nested NF2/TL Toggle instances: switch Value to hide / lock / outline the layer.

v2 · System & Components.name: NF2/TL Grid
v2 · System & Components.description: Empty-frame grid of one row: a cell per frame, every 5th frame shaded. Folder rows show a flat strip.

v2 · System & Components.name: NF2/TL Grid Lines
v2 · System & Components.description: Per-frame dividers drawn over spans, so filled frames stay countable.

v2 · System & Components.name: NF2/TL Span
v2 · System & Components.description: Frame span. Resize horizontally to frame count × 12 px. Static = frames holding content (grey), Classic / Shape tween = purple / green with arrow, Motion tween = blue (property keyframes as markers), Broken tween = dashed, Selected = frame selection.

v2 · System & Components.name: NF2/TL Marker
v2 · System & Components.description: One-frame marker placed at x = (frame − 1) × 12. Keyframe ●, Blank keyframe ○, Span end ▯, Property keyframe ◆ (motion tween), Action keyframe (a over ●). Use Tone = On Selection over selected frames.

v2 · System & Components.name: NF2/TL Frame Label
v2 · System & Components.description: Frame label (red flag), comment (green //) or anchor on a keyframe; sits on top of the span that starts at that keyframe.

v2 · System & Components.name: NF2/TL Ruler
v2 · System & Components.description: Two-row ruler at 24 fps: seconds on top, frame numbers + ticks below (12 px per frame).

v2 · System & Components.name: NF2/TL Onion Range
v2 · System & Components.description: Onion-skin range on the ruler: drag the handles to set frames before / after the playhead.

v2 · System & Components.name: NF2/TL Playhead
v2 · System & Components.description: Playhead: frame number on the frame row, current time (s) as a quiet chip on the seconds row; line through all layers.

v2 · System & Components.name: NF2/Tool Button
v2 · System & Components.description: Tool in the Tools panel: 32×32, 20 px monochrome icon. Flyout marks a tool group (long-press opens the group).

v2 · System & Components.name: NF2/Fill Stroke Chip
v2 · System & Components.description: Current fill (front) and stroke (back). Recolour Fill / Stroke per use.

v2 · System & Components.name: NF2/Color Well
v2 · System & Components.description: Stroke / fill colour target. Active = the target the colour mixer edits.

v2 · System & Components.name: NF2/Floating Panel Header
v2 · System & Components.description: Header of a detached (floating) panel: drag grip, panel tabs, panel menu, collapse, close.

v2 · System & Components.name: NF2/Icon Group
v2 · System & Components.description: Grouped icon buttons (align, distribute, transform, text align…). Swap nested icons; switch a nested item to Type=Selected for toggles.

v2 · System & Components.name: NF2/Color Field
v2 · System & Components.description: Colour value: swatch, hex, alpha. Click swatch → colour popover.

v2 · System & Components.name: NF2/Gradient Bar
v2 · System & Components.description: Gradient preview with colour stops (drag to move, click the bar to add, drag off to remove).

v2 · System & Components.name: NF2/Color Picker
v2 · System & Components.description: Colour mixer: saturation/brightness area, hue strip, alpha strip.

v2 · System & Components.name: NF2/Tools Panel
v2 · System & Components.description: Tools panel. 1 Column (docked rail): related tools grouped behind flyouts — Selection/Subselection, Free/Gradient transform, Rectangle/Oval, Pencil/Brush, Paint bucket/Ink bottle. 2 Columns (floating, Flash layout): every tool visible, plus View, Colors (fill/stroke, default, none, swap) and Options (snap, tool options). Icons are monochrome 20 px.

v2 · System & Components.name: NF2/Stage Ruler
v2 · System & Components.description: Stage ruler in stage units at 75 % zoom. The "0" mark sits 375 px from the start (horizontal) / 225 px from the top (vertical): place the instance so 0 meets the stage origin. Drag out of a ruler to create a guide.

v2 · System & Components.name: NF2/Ruler Corner
v2 · System & Components.description: Ruler origin: drag to move the zero point, double-click to reset.

v2 · System & Components.name: NF2/Guide
v2 · System & Components.description: Ruler guide. Resize along its axis to span the canvas. Selected shows the drag handle; Locked guides are dashed and cannot be moved.

v2 · System & Components.name: NF2/Stage Grid
v2 · System & Components.description: Stage grid overlay (20 px spacing, every 5th line stronger) drawn above the stage background, below content unless "Show over objects" is on.

v2 · System & Components.name: NF2/View Settings
v2 · System & Components.description: View settings popover for rulers, guides and grid. Opens from the settings button in the canvas view bar (next to the rulers / guides / grid / snap toggles) and from View ▸ Rulers, Guides & Grid…

v2 · System & Components.name: NF2/Swatches Popover
v2 · System & Components.description: Quick colour access. Opens from the fill/stroke chip in Tools, from any colour well and colour field. Hex + alpha, no colour, eyedropper, open full mixer; recent colours, document swatches (+ add), palette (switchable), gradient presets.

v2 · System & Components.name: NF2/Ease Graph
v2 · System & Components.description: Ease curve graph. Overshoot / Undershoot variants extend the Y axis to −30…130 % and tint the out-of-range bands; handles outside 0–100 % turn amber (back / anticipation easing).

v2 · System & Components.name: NF2/Stepper Field
v2 · System & Components.description: Numeric field with ▲▼ steppers; drag the prefix to scrub, ↑/↓ steps, ⇧ = ×10.

v2 · System & Components.name: NF2/Combo Field
v2 · System & Components.description: Editable value + preset menu (stroke size, angles, inner radius…).

v2 · System & Components.name: NF2/Breadcrumb Item
v2 · System & Components.description: Editing path: Scene ▸ symbol ▸ nested symbol. Click an item to go back up; the ▾ menu lists siblings (scenes / symbols) with search.

v2 · System & Components.name: NF2/Registration Picker
v2 · System & Components.description: Compact 3×3 registration / transformation point picker (28 px). Click a dot; arrow keys move it.

v2 · System & Components.name: NF2/Selection Box
v2 · System & Components.description: Object selection on stage: Group (thin), Symbol instance (registration + transformation point), Static text (round handle = auto width), Dynamic/input text (square handle = fixed size), Primitive (extra control points for angles / inner radius). Resize to the object bounds.

v2 · System & Components.name: NF2/Transform Box
v2 · System & Components.description: Free transform: Scale mode (8 square handles; ⇧ keeps proportions, ⌥ from centre), Rotate & skew (round corner handles rotate, edge bars skew). White circle = transformation point.

v2 · System & Components.name: NF2/Bezier Handle
v2 · System & Components.description: Direction line from an anchor to its control point. Rotate/resize along the tangent.

v2 · System & Components.name: NF2/Shape Selection
v2 · System & Components.description: Raw (ungrouped) shape selected: hatch mesh over the selected fill / stroke. Place clipped inside the shape outline.

v2 · System & Components.name: NF2/Gradient Transform
v2 · System & Components.description: Gradient transform tool: centre (move), focal triangle (radial focus), square (width / aspect), circle (size), filled circle (rotation).

v2 · System & Components.name: NF2/Snap Ring
v2 · System & Components.description: Snap to objects indicator: thick ring at the registration point while dragging; it jumps to a larger ring when snapped.
